scope: Restored Wannsee villa exterior: hipped tiled roof with eyebrow dormer, columned street facade, lake-facing pediment and loggia, shutters and raised terrace. Exclude the wider garden and separate garden house.

originalReview.notes: Entire1518×1177published Qualla original individually inspected. The1918painting shows the lake-facing main villa, two-storey window/door axes, central pilaster division, terrace/steps and left open loggia. Roof apex and some flank details are cropped/obscured; the image alone is not a whole-building survey. Restored standing architecture is independently described by the heritage authority and restoring architects.
